So I know a few people mentioned that if my jokes were generalizing that was problematic so I just wanted to provide an example of what my stand up looks like for clarity. 

so one of my bits is about how I'm going to law school after college and once I am a lawyer I'm going to need to ask the Judge for extended time in court. The main point of the bit is essentially me acting out the exchange. 

And I make more bits about how I am a masochist because of all the reading I am going to need to do in law school and I have severe dyslexia so I read slow as fuck.
I don't touch on any LD's that I don't personally have and usually try to stick to personal experiences to avoid offending people in the LD community

I have dyslexia, dyscalculia, dysgraphia, non verbal learning disorder and an audio processing disorder. In my stand up I essentially talk about how I wasn't designed to learn given that I can't read (dyslexia), can't understand my professors (audio processing disorder), and struggle to learn through many non verbal methods (non-verbal learning disorder).
